name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Solutions Consultant | Discovery, Demos, AE Enablement & Deal Acceleration
summary: Client-facing SaaS seller and product advocate with 7+ years running discovery and demos, plus the enablement work that makes a sales team better. Ranked top three in sales at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, running discovery and scoping with C-suite buyers and mapping each deal's stakeholders and implementation plan. Writes demo talk tracks, messaging frameworks, and plain-language content, and uses AI daily to speed up research, prep, and follow-up. Salesforce and Salesloft fluent. Denver based, ready for hybrid.
